title: Mindset, Self-Efficacy, and Quality of Professional Life Among Psychotherapists
summary:
In this study, we examine the professional experiences of psychotherapists. The focus is on personal perspectives, coping with the demands of daily professional life, and both positive and stressful experiences in psychotherapeutic practice.
The goal is to better understand the factors associated with professional well-being and stress. The findings could provide a basis for designing training, prevention, and support programs.

interventions.name: Psychotherapists are invited to participate in an online survey. The survey takes about 20–25 minutes to complete.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Psychotherapists in training or continuing education, as well as licensed psychotherapists who are currently practicing psychotherapy and have at least one active treatment case
Exclusion criteria:
none
